name: Zulfikar Ali Bhutto
role: Founder of the Pakistan Peoples Party and Prime Minister of Pakistan
contribution: He founded the Pakistan Peoples Party in 1967 and became a central actor in Pakistan's post-1970 political transition, including negotiations around East Pakistan during the 1971 crisis.
context: Late-Pakistan period constitutional conflict, the 1970 election aftermath, and the state restructuring phase after 1971.
impact: His decisions and negotiations shaped Pakistan's political trajectory and influenced how the East Pakistan crisis moved toward war and eventual separation.
